neighbours.label: the article ' a' right after a verb of forming or building ('form a circle', 'build a relationship')
fire: The children held hands to form a ring around the tree.
It took the two firms a decade to build a partnership.
After the storm the villagers formed a committee to repair the hall.
Her plan is to build a career in marine biology.
The birds form a long line as they cross the bay.
Good teachers build a bond with every class.
Several small clubs joined together to form a league.
Over the years the brothers managed to build a reputation for honest work.
quiet: The children held hands and sang a song around the tree.
It took the two firms a decade to settle a dispute.
After the storm the villagers found a boat inside the hall.
Her plan is to take a course in marine biology.
The birds follow a long river as they cross the bay.
Good teachers tell a story to every class.
Several small clubs met together to watch a match.
Over the years the brothers managed to save a fortune from honest work.
